_comment: A tiny local 'knowledge base' shipped with the module. The agent's kb_lookup tool reads this file. Keys are lowercased on lookup. Facts are deliberately small, unambiguous, and self-contained so a 1.7B model can chain them.
smollm2 parameters: 1.7 billion for the largest instruct model in the family
react paper: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models (Yao et al., 2022)
